prompt.zh-TW: 藍鯨水族用現金 {{money:vars.cost}} 買了一座展示用的大型水族缸，預計用五年以上。這筆現金流出在現金流量表上放在哪一類活動？
prompt.en: Blue Whale Aquatics pays {{money:vars.cost}} in cash for a large display aquarium it expects to use for more than five years. Under which activity does this outflow appear on the statement of cash flows?

text.zh-TW: 投資活動，因為買的是要用好幾年的設備
text.en: Investing activities, because it buys equipment that will be used for years

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。買會用很多年的設備，是把錢投到長期資產上。
feedback.en: Nice work. Buying equipment that will serve for years is putting cash into a long-term asset.

text.zh-TW: 營業活動，因為水族缸是用來賣魚的
text.en: Operating activities, because the aquarium is used to sell fish

feedback.zh-TW: 水族缸確實是為了做生意才買的，這點沒錯。不過營業活動指的是日常的收付：進貨、付貨款、付開銷。買一座用好幾年的設備是一次性的長期投入，放投資活動，之後每年的折舊才會進損益表。
feedback.en: The aquarium was indeed bought for the business, that much is right. But operating activities are the day-to-day receipts and payments: buying stock, paying suppliers, paying expenses. Buying equipment that lasts for years is a one-off long-term outlay, placed under investing; its depreciation then reaches the income statement year by year.

text.zh-TW: 籌資活動，因為花了一大筆錢
text.en: Financing activities, because it is a large sum

feedback.zh-TW: 金額確實不小，這點沒錯。不過分類看的是這筆錢的性質與用途，不是金額大小；籌資活動是向股東或銀行等資金提供者取得資金、償還借款本金與發放股利，買長期設備不屬於這一類。
feedback.en: It is indeed a large sum, that much is right. But the classification depends on the nature of the cash flow and what it is for, not on its size; financing covers raising funds from shareholders or lenders, repaying loan principal and paying dividends, and buying long-term equipment is not one of them.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}記錄公司買進或賣出長期資產的現金，例如{{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}。這筆支出是{{option:o_9bax}}；選{{option:o_0dj6}}是把「為了做生意」和「日常營業收付」混在一起，選{{option:o_4chk}}則是用金額大小來分類。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_9hrfpqem}} record the cash a company spends on or receives from long-term assets such as {{term:tm_gt8g4afe}}. This payment is {{option:o_9bax}}; choosing {{option:o_0dj6}} confuses ‘for the business’ with day-to-day operating receipts and payments, and choosing {{option:o_4chk}} classifies by size.
